TS0230001.message: A Pipeline with id '{id}' already exists.
TS0230001.solution: Choose a different Pipeline id, or edit the existing Pipeline.

TS0230002.solution: List Pipelines to find an existing id.

TS0230003.message: Pipeline id '{bodyId}' in the request body does not match path id '{pathId}'.
TS0230003.solution: Use the same immutable Pipeline id in the request path and body.

TS0230004.message: Pipeline '{id}' requires its current ETag for this operation.
TS0230004.solution: Read the Pipeline, then retry with its ETag in If-Match.

TS0230005.message: Pipeline '{id}' changed after it was read.
TS0230005.solution: Read the current Pipeline and retry the operation with its new ETag.

TS0230006.message: The selected start change did not change Pipeline '{id}'. Nothing was started.
TS0230006.solution: Check the offered action and the Pipeline definition, then retry with a change that can be applied.

TS0230007.message: Pipeline '{id}' cannot be changed together with its draft by this store. Nothing was started.
TS0230007.solution: Use a store that supports atomic definition and draft updates, or edit and publish the draft before starting.
